Priya (AE): Heads-up — ProspectY's security reviewer pushed back on SIG answers; they need evidence for Q45 (HSM/tenant key separation), Q52 (KMS rotation proof), and Q68 (east-west segmentation). They want a single zipped bundle and the chain-of-custody file. Can Security/Infra take ownership?
Omar (Security): I'll own Q45 and the chain-of-custody doc. We have per-tenant KMS key aliases and HSM partitions for Dedicated clusters. Will attach key alias export and attestation PDF.
Casey (Infra): I'll handle Q68 and Q52; can export firewall rules and rotation logs. Which region and cluster?
Priya (AE): Region: us-west-2, cluster: redwood-dedicated-py-02. Customer specifically requested proof that rotated keys were used to re-encrypt existing secrets.
Casey (Infra): Got it. I'll pull re-encrypt job logs and the rotation events. CLI snippets below for inclusion:
Casey (Infra): ```bash
$ aws kms list-aliases --profile prod | grep prod/prospecty
alias/prod/prospecty-key    2025-09-12
$ aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name "/redwood/kms-rotation" --query "events[?message like 're-encrypt']" --start-time 1690000000000
```
Omar (Security): Attestation note: HSM provider supplied an OOB attestation PDF (redacted) and nonce; storing in S3. Also creating a short md file linking the cert chain and the HSM partition IDs.
AuditBot: Evidence guidance: please include metadata.csv with fields: artifact_name, artifact_type, created_by, sha256sum. Template: https://redwood.internal/sec/evidence-guidance.csv
Leah (SalesOps): I'll bundle and timestamp-sign the package. Drop files to s3://redwood-evidence/prospecty/2167894321/pending/ and I'll pick them up. ETA 4 hours.
Casey (Infra): Uploaded: reencrypt_joblog.txt, firewall_rules_usw2.json (redacted), cluster_node_annotations.yaml.
Omar (Security): Uploaded: hsm_attestation_redacted.pdf, key_alias_export.csv, chain_of_custody.md
Leah (SalesOps): Assembling now. Will include a short README describing redaction decisions.
Priya (AE): Thanks team. I'll let the customer know we'll deliver by COB PT; will flag if they request raw cert material (we won't share raw private keys).
Leah (SalesOps): Package archived and signed: s3://redwood-evidence/prospecty/2167894321/prospecty-sig-bundle-v1.zip. Sent to reviewer.
Priya (AE): Reviewer replied: 'Received. Can you confirm rotation policy cadence and last KMS rotation timestamp?'
Casey (Infra): Replying with snippet: 'rotation_period_days=90; last_rotation=2025-11-01T03:12:08Z'
Omar (Security): Also added note: 'HSM attestation nonce verification completed by SecOps on 2025-11-02; verifier: Omar'
Priya (AE): Closing thread unless they ask for more. Thanks all. :tada:
